d: Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi is a luxurious hospitality establishment that seamlessly combines modern elegance with world-class amenities. Nestled in the heart of Abu Dhabi, our resort offers an unparalleled experience for both leisure and business travelers. With a prime waterfront location, Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi sets itself apart as a premier destination for those seeking a blend of sophistication, comfort, and personalized service.

Enjoy breathtaking views of the marina and the Abu Dhabi skyline from the comfort of our well-appointed rooms and suites. The strategic location allows guests to immerse themselves in the vibrant atmosphere of the city.
Our accommodations are designed to provide the utmost comfort and style. Each room and suite is meticulously furnished with modern amenities, ensuring a relaxing and enjoyable stay for every guest.
Indulge your palate with a diverse array of culinary delights at our on-site restaurants. From international cuisines to local flavors, our chefs craft exquisite dishes that cater to every taste.

Whether you're here for business or leisure, Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi offers a range of facilities to meet your needs. Our conference and event spaces are equipped with cutting-edge technology, while our wellness facilities provide a rejuvenating experience.
At Rixos Marina Abu Dhabi, we take pride in delivering personalized and attentive service. Our dedicated staff is committed to ensuring that every guest's stay is memorable and exceeds expectations.
r: Leadership & Strategy Development: Lead and develop the overall marketing strategy in alignment with Rixos Properties’ business goals. Manage the marketing department, ensuring effective execution of all marketing initiatives and campaigns across digital, traditional, and experiential channels.

Brand Vision & Positioning: Oversee and refine the brand’s positioning, ensuring consistency and alignment with the company’s mission, values, and target market. Drive brand awareness and maintain a strong brand identity across all platforms and touchpoints.

Integrated Marketing Campaigns: Develop and implement integrated marketing campaigns to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention. Ensure that all marketing campaigns are cohesive, well-executed, and deliver measurable results.

Digital Transformation: Lead the digital marketing efforts, ensuring a robust online presence through SEO/SEM, social media, content marketing, email campaigns, and paid media. Foster innovation in digital marketing practices and lead the company’s digital transformation initiatives.

Market Research & Insights: Leverage market research, data analytics, and customer insights to stay ahead of industry trends, understand audience needs, and identify opportunities for growth and market penetration.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with senior leadership, sales, and revenue management teams to align marketing efforts with revenue goals and business objectives. Ensure strong communication and collaboration across departments.
Budget & Resource Management: Develop and manage the marketing budget, ensuring cost-effective use of resources to maximize ROI. Optimize resource allocation across all marketing initiatives.

Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing marketing team. Promote a culture of creativity, collaboration, and innovation. Provide guidance and professional development opportunities to team members.
Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for marketing-related matters, presenting strategy, updates, and results to senior executives and stakeholders.
Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Track, analyze, and report on the performance of all marketing campaigns. Provide actionable insights to continuously improve and optimize marketing efforts.
Public Relations & Brand Partnerships: Manage public relations strategies and work with key partners, influencers, and media outlets to expand brand reach and maintain a positive brand reputation.
Sustainability Integration: Ensure that marketing initiatives align with the company’s sustainability goals by promoting eco-friendly and ethical practices through marketing strategies.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. MBA or equivalent advanced degree is highly preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 10 years of marketing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, preferably in the hospitality, luxury, or service industry.
Leadership Skills: Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing large teams, influencing cross-functional teams, and driving organizational change.
Strategic Thinking: Exceptional ability to think strategically and translate business goals into effective marketing initiatives and campaigns.
Digital Marketing Expertise: Deep knowledge of digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, social media marketing, content marketing, and email marketing.
Creativity & Innovation: A forward-thinking, innovative mindset with the ability to develop creative marketing solutions that drive brand growth and engagement.
Analytical & Data-Driven: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, measure campaign performance, and make data-driven decisions.
Excellent Communication: Superior verbal and written communication skills, capable of articulating marketing strategies and results to senior leadership and external partners.
Budget & Resource Management: Experience in managing substantial marketing budgets and resources, with a track record of maximizing ROI.

Sustainability: Commit to and maintain sustainable practices by enhancing resource efficiency, minimizing waste, and promoting eco-friendly, social, and ethical initiatives. Align with the hotel’s broader ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) and CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) objectives to drive a positive impact across all pillars of sustainability.

Compliance and Standards: Ensure full compliance with local legal requirements, international standards, health and safety regulations, company policies, ISO standards, and industry best practices. Continuously review and update operational processes to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements.

Food Safety & Hygiene: Ensure full compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations by overseeing proper purchasing, storage, handling, maintenance, communication, and preparation practices across all departments.

We are looking for a Legal Specialist to join MOZN's legal team and support the company across a broad range of legal, commercial, corporate, regulatory, and compliance matters. The Legal Specialist will work collaboratively with other members of the Legal team, with responsibilities shared across the function rather than being limited to a specific legal specialization. The role will interact closely with commercial, finance, procurement, HR, product, cybersecurity, and other business teams.
q: Bachelor's degree in Law or a related legal discipline.
Minimum 2 years of relevant legal experience , preferably within a corporate legal department, law firm, technology company, or similar environment.
Good understanding of commercial contracts and general corporate legal matters.
Familiarity with Saudi Arabian laws and regulations is preferred.
Experience within technology, SaaS, fintech, financial services, or another regulated sector would be an advantage.
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Strong Arabic written and verbal communication skills.
Good contract drafting, review, and negotiation skills.
Strong legal research and analytical ability.
Ability to translate legal requirements into practical business advice.
Strong attention to detail and document-management discipline.
Ability to manage multiple matters and priorities simultaneously.
Comfortable working across different areas of law rather than within a narrow specialization.
Proactive, collaborative, and capable of working with different functions and levels of management.
High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and integrity.
r: Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize a wide range of commercial agreements, including customer contracts, SaaS agreements, MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, vendor and supplier agreements, partnership agreements, and amendments.
Review RFPs, RFIs, customer terms, procurement documents, and other documentation with legal implications for Mozn.
Provide practical legal advice and support to internal stakeholders on day-to-day commercial and operational matters.
Support corporate governance matters, including preparation and maintenance of shareholder and board resolutions, corporate records, powers of attorney, authorizations, and constitutional documents.
Assist with corporate matters including company registrations, licenses, renewals, amendments, subsidiaries, branches, and other corporate requirements.
Support regulatory and governmental matters, including filings, submissions, registrations, inquiries, and correspondence with relevant authorities.
Assist with compliance activities, including KYC, AML, UBO, customer and vendor due diligence, regulatory questionnaires, and related documentation.
Monitor relevant laws and regulations and support the Legal team in assessing their impact on MOZN's activities.
Support matters relating to data protection, confidentiality, intellectual property, employment, and other areas affecting the company's operations.
Assist with disputes, claims, settlement discussions, and coordination with external legal counsel when required.
Identify and communicate legal and contractual risks and recommend practical mitigation measures.
Maintain legal records, contract repositories, regulatory trackers, corporate documentation, and renewal deadlines.
Support the development and improvement of legal templates, policies, processes, playbooks, and internal controls.
Coordinate with external counsel, regulators, government authorities, corporate service providers, customers, vendors, banks, auditors, and other external stakeholders as required.
Undertake legal research and prepare concise legal opinions, summaries, and recommendations for management.
Support the Legal team on any other legal, regulatory, governance, or compliance matters arising from MOZN's operations.
This scope reflects the breadth already present across MOZN's legal function, covering commercial contracting as well as governance, licensing, regulatory, KYC/UBO and corporate matters.

We are seeking a dynamic and accomplished Managing Director to lead operations across four prestigious hotel properties (Fairmont, Raffles, Swissôtel & Swissôtel Al Maqam - Makkah). The ideal candidate will possess exceptional leadership capabilities, a strong commercial mindset, and a proven track record in driving operational excellence, guest satisfaction, and financial performance within the hospitality industry. This role requires a visionary leader who can inspire teams, strengthen brand positioning, and deliver sustainable business growth across all properties. The ideal candidate should be able to:
Execute common strategic priorities across the four hotels while maintaining each brands’ positioning and operational standards.
Maximize synergies and coordinated decision-making across commercial, operational, people and culture, as well as support functions to optimize overall complex performance.
Enhance efficiency through shared resources and centralized expertise, avoiding duplication of functions and costs across individual properties.
Ensure aligned strategic direction, effective commercial management, optimized resource allocation, and seamless execution across the complex.
lead consolidated business reporting, strategic planning, capital planning discussions, forecasting, and long-term positioning of the complex within the market.
Develop and execute long-term business strategies for all four hotels.
Set annual goals, KPIs, and growth targets, identify expansion, repositioning, Lead organizational transformation and innovation initiatives
Ensure alignment with ownership vision and Accor brand standards.
Drive profitability across all properties, review monthly P&L statements and variance reports, ensure compliance with financial and audit procedures
Standardize operational procedures where appropriate, maintain quality assurance and service consistency, conduct regular hotel inspections and performance reviews
Analyse market trends and competitor positioning, enhance brand visibility and market share.
Ensure exceptional guest satisfaction across all hotels, review guest feedback and online reputation scores, maintain luxury/service standards.
Ensure compliance of all hotels with health & Safety regulations, licensing, fire and security standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
Minimum 10–15 years of progressive leadership experience within the hospitality industry, including multi-property management experience.
Proven track record in driving revenue growth, profitability, and operational excellence across hotel operations.
Strong leadership and people management skills with the ability to lead diverse teams across multiple locations.
Extensive knowledge of hotel operations, including Rooms Division, Food & Beverage, Sales & Marketing, Finance, and Guest Services.
Demonstrated experience in budgeting, financial planning, forecasting, and performance management.
Excellent strategic planning, negotiation, and decision-making capabilities.
Strong understanding of brand standards, quality assurance, and guest satisfaction metrics.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to develop and implement business strategies that support long-term growth and operational efficiency.
Experience working with international hospitality brands or luxury hotel groups is an advantage.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify market opportunities and drive competitive positioning.
High level of professionalism, integrity, and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.
